title: GRACE: Grounded Adversarial Reasoning over Canadian Law
abstract: arXiv:2609.23726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance across a range of legal tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the ability to take and defend a legal position, reason under incomplete information, or synthesize multiple statutory provisions. This gap is particularly pronounced for Canadian law, which remains underrepresented in legal NLP. We introduce GRACE (Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples), a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation. translated_title: GRACE：基于加拿大法律的接地对抗性推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在一系列法律任务中已展现出强大性能，但现有基准很少评估模型持有并辩护法律立场的能力、在不完整信息下进行推理的能力，或综合多个法律条款的能力。这一差距在加拿大法律领域尤为突出，因为加拿大法律在法律自然语言处理（NLP）中的代表性仍然不足。我们推出了GRACE（Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples，基于加拿大法律示例的接地对抗推理），这是一个包含1,915个问题-推理-答案实例的数据集，其内容植根于加拿大联邦立法。GRACE涵盖三种推理模式：对抗性辩护、不确定性推理和应用推理。我们开发了一套流程，该流程对原始法律条文进行切分、生成基于场景的问题与推理，并通过无模型的引用验证和基于大语言模型的质量审计来筛选示例。作为概念验证，我们微调了CLeAR-4B（Canadian Legal Adversarial Reasoning，加拿大法律对抗推理），这是一个用于接地法律推理的轻量级模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了GRACE数据集，包含1,915个基于加拿大联邦立法的问题-推理-答案实例，涵盖对抗性辩护、不确定性和应用推理三种模式，并配套开发了数据构建流程及微调了轻量级法律推理模型CLeAR-4B，填补了加拿大法律在法律NLP基准测试中的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GRACE, a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation covering adversarial advocacy, uncertainty, and applied reasoning modes, along with a data construction pipeline and a fine-tuned lightweight legal reasoning model CLeAR-4B, addressing the underrepresentation of Canadian law in legal NLP benchmarks.
